title: Number of Connected Components
summary: Given n nodes and a list of undirected edges, count how many separate pieces the graph falls into.

tests.explain: 0, 1 and 2 are linked into one piece and 3-4 is another: 2 components.
The edge 2-0 closes a loop inside an existing piece, so it merges nothing. The pieces are {0, 1, 2}, {3, 4} and the lone node 5: 3 components.
With no edges every node is its own component.

hints: Before any edge is added, there are n components: every node alone.
An edge between two nodes in different components merges them, so the count drops by one. An edge inside one component changes nothing.
Keep a union-find with a count field. union(a, b) returns false when a and b already share a root; only decrement the count when it returns true.

complexity.time: O(n + E · α(n)): building the arrays plus one near-constant union per edge
